priorities.summary: Cisco disclosed on Sep 30 that attackers are actively exploiting a URI-encoding flaw in Catalyst SD-WAN Manager that lets an unauthenticated remote attacker use the management API as the admin user. Every on-prem release is affected, there is no workaround, and CISA added it to KEV with an Oct 3 remediation deadline.

MikroTik RouterOS before 7.24 carries an integer-underflow flaw in the web management service that executes before the login check — a single crafted HTTP request can yield root code execution or denial of service. CISA published advisory ICSA-26-272-06 on Sep 29.

Digiwin EasyFlow .NET has an insecure-deserialization vulnerability (CWE-502) that lets unauthenticated remote attackers execute arbitrary code on the server via crafted serialized content. Published Sep 30; no public exploit confirmed yet.

model.name: Gemini 4 Argon
model.summary: Google's new flagship AI model tops coding and automation benchmarks (77.9% on DeepSWE, first on AutomationBench) with an industry-leading 1M-token output limit, but Google is withholding it from public release — restricting access to a vetted group of cybersecurity experts while the US government gets early access.
